newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Sailor dies as Panamanian freighter catches fire.
newsitem.headline: Sailor dies as Panamanian freighter catches fire.

text.p: One crew member was killed and four injured on Thursday when a fire broke out on board a freighter at the outer anchorage of Mongla port, port officials said.
They said the deceased was a Filipino, adding another three Filipinos and a Sri Lankan had been injured.
The fire started at 9.00 a.m. (0300 GMT) while the ship, the Panamanian-flagged Alexandria, was anchored some 30 miles (45 km) from Bangladesh's Hiron Point naval station.
Navy boats rushed to the scene and extinguished the blaze, the cause of which was not immediately known.
The vessel arrived from Singapore early on Thursday, carrying jute and was due to leave for Belgium after further loading at Mongla, the officials told reporters.
"We only have the first reports. We are still awaiting details," one official said.
